messages.body_plain:
From: Ariel Duarte López [mailto:adu...@ac.upc.edu]
Sent: Wednesday, April 10, 2019 5:52 PM
Cc: marta...@upc.edu
Subject: XIII Summer School MESIO UPC-UB

Dear all,

The Facultat de matemàtiques i Estadística (UPC) organizes the XIII Summer School MESIO UPC-UB from June 17th to July 5th.

The XIII edition contains 11 regular courses and 2 special courses taught by either in English or in Spanish . The regular courses are 15 hours long and include lectures and practical labs. Some courses are more methodological and some others more practical. This edition contains several courses related to machine learning and deep learning from basic knowledge to advanced. They are also interesting courses related to Data Science in general, and an Introductory course on discrete Value time series, which is a quite new and active research area in statistics. For those students willing to have a certificate an evaluation will be given.

The registration starts the 2nd of May, and more detailed information of the courses as well as the Summer School in general may be found in the link below:

https://mesioupcub.masters.upc.edu/en/xiii-summer-school-2019

Thank you very much for your attention, and if you need further information please do not hesitate to contact Carme Capdevila at gestio.summ...@upc.edu for administrative aspects, and myself for academical issues.

Best wishes

Marta Pérez-Casany (direccio.sum...@upc.edu)

Dept. d'Estadística i investigació Operativa.

Technical University of Catalonia

messages.subject: R dilema
messages.body_plain:
Pozdrav vsem,

imam dilemo glede uporabe pairwise.wilcox.test, in sicer nisem prepričana, kaj bi izbrala za p.adjust.method. V R priročniku je navedeno, da sta BH in fdr 'močnejši' od preostalih možnosti, zato se nagibam k uporabi ene od teh dveh.
Najprej sem naredila Kruskal-Wallis test (kruskal.test), ki je nakazal obstoj statistično značilne razlike med testiranimi skupinami. Z namenom, da bi ugotovila, med katerimi skupinami obstajajo statistično značilne razlike, sem nadalje izvedla še pairwise.wilcox.test. Pri tem z p.adjust.method = ''none'', ''BH'' ali ''fdr'' dobim enake rezultate (v smislu med katerimi skupinami obstajajo statistično značilne razlike). Če pa za p.adjust.method izberem ''BY'', ''bonferroni'', ''hommel'', ''hochberg'' ali ''holm'', pa se pokaže kot da med nobenimi skupinami ni statistično značilne razlike. Glede na vse se, kot rečeno, nagibam k ''BH'' ali ''fdr''.

Tule vas je veliko, ki imate uporabo statističnih metod in R v malem prstu in bom vesela vaših mnenj  v zvezi z izbiro p.adjust.method. Sama si ne uspem povsem razjasniti, katero možnost bi bilo najbolje uporabiti. Glede na rezultate, ki jih dobim, sta ''BH'' ali ''fdr'' logična izbira, vendar pa ne želim, da bi me logičnost rezultata kakorkoli zavedla, zato bi rada slišala mnenje koga od vas, ki imate o tem več znanja in izkušenj.

Lp, Maja

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Maja Mohorović

messages.body_plain:
Po mojem je izbira posthoc testa _posthoc_ glede na rezultat, ki jih dajo, slaba izbira. Za to se je pravilno odločiti še preden narediš test, ravno zaradi tega, da te ne premami signifikantnost. To kar delaš je obiranje češenj. Jaz bi predstavil vse rezultate in to upošteval v interpretaciji.
Ne pozabiti, da je tudi nesignifikanca rezultat.

lp,
Roman

Ja, še malo bo treba tuhtat.
Lp, Maja

Presenters at last year's conference have been effusive in their praise for WSDS. The conference gave them a platform to discuss subjects such as diversity and inclusion in statistics, opportunities to share their work and connect with new collaborators, and a supportive environment to present at—some for the first time!

The deadline for  concurrent, panel, and speed session abstract submissions <http://ASASSOC.informz.net/z/cjUucD9taT04NDcyMzYxJnA9MSZ1PTEwOTQ3NTU2NjImbGk9NjQ4ODcyOTE/index.html> is this Friday, April 19, so don't miss this final opportunity to be part of the WSDS 2019 program in Bellevue, Washington!

Get More Submission Info  <http://ASASSOC.informz.net/z/cjUucD9taT04NDcyMzYxJnA9MSZ1PTEwOTQ3NTU2NjImbGk9NjQ4ODcyOTM/index.html>

Wherever you are in your career, participating in WSDS 2019 is a valuable opportunity to present your work or research or share your perspective on the role of women in today's statistics and data science fields.

Keep in mind the conference's three themes:

Share knowledge with a technical talk about important new techniques or cutting-edge research

Build community with a discussion establishing new collaborations, supporting mentoring relationships, or sharing strategies for resolving problems

Grow influence by providing advice for building and sustaining successful careers or developing leadership skills

Find your place on the program in October by  submitting an abstract <http://ASASSOC.informz.net/z/cjUucD9taT04NDcyMzYxJnA9MSZ1PTEwOTQ3NTU2NjImbGk9NjQ4ODcyOTU/index.html> by Friday, April 19!
